args.command: od -c /workspace/logs/app.log.3.gz | tail -5; echo "===gz2==="; zcat /workspace/logs/app.log.2.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -3; od -c /workspace/logs/app.log.2.gz | tail -3

python3 -c "
import gzip, io
with open('/workspace/logs/app.log.3.gz','rb') as f:
    data = f.read()
print('len', len(data))
try:
    d = gzip.decompress(data)
    print('ok', len(d))
except Exception as e:
    print('err', e)
# try raw inflate
import zlib
try:
    d = zlib.decompress(data, 16+zlib.MAX_WBITS)
    print('raw ok', len(d))
except Exception as e:
    print('raw err', e)
"
